name: cache-meter
description: Band above the prompt showing prompt-cache time left, context used, and a Compact button

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the API keeps this session's prompt cache after the last request (1h on subscription plans, 5m on API keys or usage overage)

warnMinutes.title: Warn when this many minutes remain
warnMinutes.description: Shows a toast once when the cache is about to expire

keepWarmCutoffHours.title: Keep warm: stop after this many idle hours
keepWarmCutoffHours.description: Keep warm turns itself off once the session has had no turns for this long
